about.title: Iraq Flaring Watch
about.desc: Gas flaring burns off associated gas from oil extraction, harming nearby communities and wasting billions in energy value annually.
about.economic_waste: Economic waste — USD value lost & Iraqi homes that could have been powered
about.emission_plumes: Emission plumes — methane & CO2 in kg/hr

tour.welcome_text: This map tracks gas flaring across Iraq — where natural gas is burned off during oil extraction, wasting billions and harming nearby communities. Let's take a quick tour.
tour.stats_text: These live figures show the scale of the problem: gas value wasted, electricity that could be generated, and how many Iraqis live near a flare.
tour.layers_data_text: Orange dots are active flares. Purple bubbles show wasted gas value. Cyan dots are satellite-detected emission plumes. The heatmap shows flare density.
tour.controls_text: Use these controls to toggle data layers on and off, and switch between satellite, street, and night-time views.
tour.explore_text: Click any flare to see details. Every view has a shareable link that captures exactly what you're looking at — perfect for highlighting a specific site.
